claim: The paired MMLU, GSM8K, and HumanEval quality populations and deterministic prompt/scoring boundaries are frozen without using an NPU.

validation.result: full request populations generated with expected counts and stable hashes
manifest unit tests 2/2 pass in the fixed image, network disabled, no NPU devices
strict text scorer unit tests 2/2 pass in the fixed image, network disabled, no NPU devices
tokenizer.json and chat_template.jinja are byte-identical between checkpoints; tokenizer_config defaults differ, so both launchers pin the BF16 tokenizer
quality request runner unit tests 2/2 pass in the fixed image, network disabled, no NPU devices
sandboxed upstream HumanEval example executed 6 completions: 3 pass, 3 fail/timeout, pass@1 0.5
HumanEval preparation and paired scorer unit tests 4/4 pass in the fixed image, network disabled, no NPU devices

limitations: No model response, accuracy, or performance result is claimed.
Rendered chat-template prompt hashes can only be compared after each serving arm is started.
HumanEval generated code must be executed only in a restricted disposable CPU container.
